citation.authors: McKay DL, Chen CY, Saltzman E, Blumberg JB

cited_by.title: Hibiscus (sorrel, zobo, bissap) and blood pressure

record.population: 65 pre- and mildly hypertensive US adults aged 30 to 70, not on blood-pressure drugs
record.design: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 3 servings of hibiscus tea a day for 6 weeks
record.finding: Systolic pressure fell 7.2 mmHg on hibiscus against 1.3 mmHg on placebo (P=0.030). Diastolic did not differ from placebo.
record.note: Ethnic make-up of participants not in the abstract.
